Commentary.Commentary: So 298 is the total for Pakistan to chase if they are to win the series at their own den. Can the Men in Green do it or will Sri Lanka follow their impressive batting performance with the ball and stun the home fans? Join us after the break to find out.

As for Pakistan's bowling, it was not as impressive as it was two days ago. Mohammad Amir was the pick of the bowlers picking up a 3-fer. All the other bowlers except Iftikhar Ahmed had a wicket to their name. The bowlers were not well supported by the fielders as the hosts were below average with their effort on the field.

After electing to bat, Sri Lanka got off to a bad start having lost Avishka Fernando early. Gunathilaka and Thirimanne then steadied the ship. The duo added 88 runs for the second wicket before the Sri Lankan skipper departed. Gunathilaka though continued his good work and made full use of his start converting it to a brilliant ton. He built good partnerships with Angelo Perera and debutant Minod Bhanuka before departing for a brilliant 133.  After his wicket it looked like a collapse was on the cards but Dasun Shanaka's cameo in the end added some much needed impetus and took Sri Lanka's total close to 300.
12 from the last and 82 from the last 10 overs has seen Sri Lanka reach an impressive total of 297.

OUT! Caught! A wicket on the final ball. A slower one, on seeing Shanaka charge out, from Riaz and the batsman is foxed. He looks to go hard but only gets a thick outside edge which goes straight to short extra cover. Haris Sohail takes a dolly over there and for a second, we look at the umpire. He wants the no-ball check and replays show that Riaz' foot is inches behind the line. SRI LANKA FINISH ON 297/9!
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a run.
A short ball, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.

Bowled, but this is a Free Hit. Riaz keeps it full and straight and Pradeep backing away, looks to slash. He misses and the ball hits the off stump and flies towards third man. Usman Shinwari does well to stop the ball but amidst all this, umpire Joel Wilson forgets to signal a Free Hit. He now smiles and signals and apologizes.

CAUGHT OFF A NO BALL! A reprieve for Shanaka. A length ball outside off, angling away, Shanaka backs away and looks to go over the off side. However, he only manages a top edge which is taken calmly by Sarfaraz running towards his right, at point. Pakistan celebrate but then, the checking for the overstepping is done. Wahab will have to re-bowl that. The batsmen crossed, but since the catch was taken, the ball becomes dead. So it will not be a single to the batsman, but only a no ball extra.
Gone, caught! But is it a no ball? Dear me, replays do show so!
FOUR! What a shot. Outside off, Shanaka backs away and smashes it between cover and mid off!
FOUR! A full toss outside off, Shanaka creams it through the covers.
Outside off, played through point for a single.
Nuwan Pradeep is the new man in.

OUT! A run out now! A yorker, around off, Sandakan defends it to the leg side and sets off for a single. Amir himself gets across to his right, picks the ball up, takes aim and has a shy at the bowler's end. Bull's eye. Sandakan is well short.
Lakshan Sandakan comes in at number 9, replacing Hasaranga.

OUT! BOWLED! Well bowled, Mohammad Amir. A near-perfect yorker, around off, slightly short of it, Hasaranga gets across and looks to invent a shot. He only manages a thin inside edge which shatters the stumps.
On middle, eased through mid on for a single.
Ball hits the batsman low on the pads. The umpire signals a leg bye.
Full and around middle, pushed straight to mid on.
Outside off, guided towards third man for a run.
A short delivery which has been pulled away. They pick up a single.
A short ball, around middle, pulled straight to short mid-wicket.
SIX! Fine shot. Full and outside off, Shanaka backs away and clears mid off. Goes all the way as well!
Outside off, a swing and a miss.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Pushed to the cover region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Clips this through mid-wicket for a run.
The batsman has driven it through mid off.
FOUR! Off the edge. Full and outside off, Shanaka throws his bat at it and gets a thick outside edge which flies past slip to the third man fence!
The batsman has played it to the point region. One run added to the total.
Full and outside off, chipped over cover for a couple.
SIX! Fine shot. Full and outside off, Shanaka backs away and lofts it as straight as a whistle over the sightscreen!

MISFIELD, AGAIN, FOUR AGAIN! A short ball, on middle, Shanaka pulls it straight to Mohammad Amir at deep backward square leg. It is a straightforward stop but somehow, somehow, somehow, he lets it through!
The batsman drives this through the covers. They pick up a single.

Full and outside off, Shanaka drives this down the ground. The fielder gets across from mid off and has a shy at the bowler's end and hits them. There is an appeal for a run out and it is referred upstairs. Replays show that a single is confirmed.
FOUR! Another misfield. Down the leg side, Shanaka flicks it through square leg. The fielder gets across to his right and looks to stop but the ball bursts though his fingers.
Outside off, played through point for a single.
Wahab Riaz time. 7-0-44-0 so far.
Down the leg side, tucked towards long leg for a run.
The batsman drives this through the covers. They pick up a single.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a single.
WIDE. Slips this down the leg side, Hasaranga misses his flick.
Wanindu Hasaranga comes in now. At number 8, with 33 balls left in the innings.

OUT! BOWLED! A perfect yorker, in line of the stumps, Gunathilaka backs away and looks to go inside out but misses. The ball goes beneath his bat and hits the timber. The crowd rejoices but the Pakistan players get across to congratulate the southpaw. What a knock. Single-handedly kept Pakistan at bay.
Outside off, Gunathilaka looks to push it to the off side but gets a bottom edge which goes on the bounce to the keeper.
Excellent yorker. Around off, dug out to the off side for a single.
Amir returns. 7-0-34-1 so far.
That ball has taken the inside edge of the batsman and thudded into his pads. One run added to the total.
Outside off, dabbed to long off for a run.
WIDE. The ball is down the leg side but the batsman still goes after it.
Down the leg side, flicked towards fine leg for a single.
Full on middle, pushed through mid on for a run.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery. They pick up a single.
Outside off, a play and a miss.

NOT OUT. No bat involved. Down the leg side, Gunathilaka looks to flick but misses. The ball hits his pads and Sarfaraz appeals for a catch but umpire Aleem Dar signals a wide. He takes the review and Snickometer signals a spike when the ball passes the pad. The wide signal is reversed.
Dasun Shanaka walks in. And do we have a review first up? Pakistan have appealed for a catch down the leg side.
OUT! Caught! Holes out this time. Full and around middle, Jayasuriya comes down the track and swings it towards deep mid-wicket. Iftikhar Ahmed takes a dolly at the fence.
The batsman charges down the wicket. The batsmen have run through for a single.
WIDE. Well outside off, left alone.
The batsman charges down the wicket. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman.
Outside off, a play and a miss.
The batsman charges down the wicket. One run added to the total.

DROPPED! Should have been taken. Full and outside off, Gunathilaka backs away and looks to go inside out. The ball goes high in the air and Mohammad Nawaz gets under it from cover but shells it. A single taken.
Landed outside off, a play and a miss.
Full and outside off, pushed through the covers for a run.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Full and outside off, Gunathilaka looks to play the reverse sweep but the ball goes off his gloves, past the keeper, to the third man fence!
Shehan Jayasuriya walks in at number 6, replacing Bhanuka.

OUT! Run Out! Anti-climatic end to a brilliant partnership here. Not a way you want to get out on your maiden outing but Bhanuka has to go. He was looking very good but poor communication has brought his end. Floated on middle and leg, Minod tucks it towards mid-wicket and calls for a single. Gunathilaka initially says yes but then turns his back on him. Mohammad Nawaz gets to the ball and sends a wild throw to the right of Sarfaraz. He collects it and shows a disgruntled face to Nawaz as he then whips the bails. Sarfaraz had too much time in his hand as Minod never tried returning back.
Delicate glance by the batsman through the fine leg region.
On the pads, Gunathilaka glances it towards mid-wicket and gets to the other end.
Follows the maximum with a calm single towards mid-wicket.
SIX! This is out of here. Flighted on off, Bhanuka comes down the track, uses his feet brilliantly and whacks it over long off for a maximum.
Floated on off, Bhanuka comes down the track and strokes it wide of sweeper cover for a couple.
Shadab Khan to start Powerplay 3. 7-0-37-0, his figures so far.
Final Powerplay of the innings. Now 5 fielders can be placed outside the 30-yard circle till the end of the innings. S

NOT OUT! The T.V umpire is convinced that Gunathilaka did not come in the way intentionally. Good length ball on top of middle and leg. Gunathilaka makes room and looks to defend but the ball hits the upper half of his bat and goes towards the bowler. Gunathilaka comes out for a run but ends up colliding with Shinwari. The Pakistan players appeal and the umpire's take it upstairs. Replay rolls in and the Third umpire is convinced that there was no intentional harm by Gunathilaka.
The umpires have gone upstairs. Gunathalika is the man in question.The question is, is he obstructing the field here?
On the pads, Bhanuka flicks it towards mid-wicket for one.
WIDE! Pressure on the bowler. Shinwari misses his line and bowls it down the leg side. Minod looks to flick but misses.
SIX! This is out of here! Shinwari bowls it slightly shorter than a length on middle and off, Bhanuka picks the length early and smashes his pull over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
Good length ball on off and middle, Bhanuka makes room and plays it to point.
FOUR LEG BYE! Bouncer from Shinwari. Bhanuka comes down and looks to pull. The ball kisses his helmet and over the head of  Sarfaraz and to the fence.
Full on off, Gunathilaka strokes it wide of cover and gets to the other end.
Usman Shinwari is back on. 6-1-26-1, his figures so far.
On off, Gunathilaka pushes it towards long off for a single.
Play and a miss. Good length ball outside off, Gunathilaka looks to defend but misses.
Full and swinging in from middle and off, Bhanuka strokes it towards mid-wicket for one. Brings up yet another 50-run stand for Sri Lanka.
A bit of delay here as the physio is out to have a look at Gunathilaka.
Just a leg bye off the Free Hit. Yorker around off, Gunathilaka looks to play the scoop but misses and the ball hits his back leg and goes to the on side allowing them to steal a leg bye.

NO BALL AND FOUR! Brilliantly played. Gunathilaka moves away from the stumps. Wahab sees he it and bowls it full outside off, Gunathilaka still manages to hit it past backward point for a boundary. Also, it is a no ball as it looks like Wahab overstepped. Free Hit to follow.
Length ball around off, Bhanuka punches it to cover for a single.
Good length ball outside off, Bhanuka looks to run it down but misses.
Short around off, Bhanuka cuts it towards point for a single.
Edged but safe. Floated on middle, Gunathilaka looks to play the reverse sweep but it goes off the top edge towards backward point for a single.
On middle, Bhanuka milks it to long on and gets to the other end.
Uppish but safe. Floated on off, Bhanuka drives it uppishly but wide of cover for a couple.
On the pads, Bhanuka glances it towards mid-wicket.
Floated on the pads, Gunathilaka flicks it towards square leg for one.
Shadab Khan is back. 6-0-31-0 so far.
Some chin music for the batsman, he lets that bouncer through to the wicket-keeper.
A bouncer outside off, Minod ducks.
The batsman has played it to the point region. They pick up a single.
Down the leg side, Bhanuka looks to flick but misses. The ball goes off his pads through leg side and a leg bye is taken.
Outside off, tapped through point for a single.
Full and around middle, flicked straight to short mid-wicket.
Wahab Riaz returns. 5-0-34-0 so far.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full and around middle, Bhanuka comes down the track and chips this over short mid-wicket for a couple.
Full and around middle, chipped down to long on for one.
The batsman rocks onto the back foot and punches the ball.
Full and outside off, Bhanuka comes down the track and pushes it to the off side for a quick run.
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a couple.

MISFIELD, FOUR! Another instance of poor fielding. A full toss outside off, Gunathilaka drives this slightly wide of mid off. Mohammad Nawaz gets across to his right but the ball comes quickly to him and bursts through. Races to the fence.
Full and outside off, driven straight to cover.
Around middle and off, defended back to the bowler.
WIDE. A bouncer, right at the head, Gunathilaka looks to pull but then bails out at the last moment. Wide signalled for height.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a run.
Alan Wilkins on air - 10 4s came in the first 10 overs. So we have had just 8 in the next 24!
Full and outside off, driven through the covers for a single.
Landed outside off, played straight to point.
Short and outside off, cut through point for one.
Full and down the leg side, Bhanuka sweeps this fine. Fakhar Zaman gives this a good chase from fine leg and keeps the batsmen to three.
Down the leg side, tucked towards long leg for a run.
Full and outside off, driven through mid off for a single.
ALMOST A RETURN CATCH! Full and around off, Bhanuka chips this back, with a loose bottom hand. Iftikhar dives in front but the ball lands just short of him.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.

DRINKS BREAK. 17 overs left. Is 275 possible from here on? Gunathilaka has got to his well-deserved ton and will now look to convert this into a daddy hundred. He though will need to get someone to support him. Pakistan have to find a way to get rid of the dangerous Gunathilaka. Iftikhar Ahmed to bowl again. 6-1-23-0 so far.
Almost! On a length outside off, Danushka looks to steer it towards third man but the ball suddenly bounces sharply and beats the outside edge.
FOUR! Lovely batting! Full and around middle, Gunathilaka lofts this as clean as a whistle over mid on, one bounce and into the fence!
Down the leg side, helped through fine leg for a single.
Full and around off, driven straight back to the bowler.
Full and around off, watchfully defended.
Landed outside off, steered behind point for a single.

HUNDRED FOR GUNATHILAKA! This has been an excellent knock from him. He has paved the way for his young teammates to follow. He gets to the milestone with a single towards cover to get to his 2nd ODI hundred. He removes his helmet and raises the bat and punches the air in delight as his teammates applaud his knock.
Fuller on off, Bhanuka pushes it towaqrds cover for one.
Play and a miss. Good length ball outside off, Bhanuka goes for the pull but misses. The ball bounces in front of Sarfaraz, he fumbles but that does not cost any run.
On top of off, Bhanuka defends it with a straight bat.
Fuller on off, Gunathilaka pushes it with soft hands towards mid on and calls for a quick single. He gets it successfully. Just a run away from a brilliant ton.
Good length ball on off, DG defends it off the back foot towards cover.
Back of a length ball on off, Gunathilaka plays it with soft hands towards cover for one. Moves to 98 with that.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Amir hits the deck hard around off, Bhanuka looks to defend but the ball goes off the outer half of his bat towards third man for a single.
Good length ball around off, Gunathilaka flicks it towards mid-wicket for one.

Just short! Brilliant ball. Good length ball outside off, it comes in off the deck. Gunathilaka looks to defend but with little to no foot movement. The ball falls short of Sarfaraz who dives in front. Initially it looked to be missing the edge but Ultra Edge shows a little spike later on.
Starts his new spell with a good length ball on middle and off, Gunathilaka defends it with calmness.
Mohammad Amir is back on. 4-0-18-1, his figures so far.
Length ball on off, Bhanuka defends it towards cover and shouts a loud no to his partner.
Good ball. Off cutter outside off, Bhanuka looks to defend but misses it completely.
Full again on off, Gunathilaka plays it with soft hands wide of mid off for one.
Bhanuka gets off the mark in international cricket. Fuller on off, Bhanuka pushes it towards mid off for one.
Fuller on the stumps, Bhanuka defends it off the front foot.
Minod Bhanuka walks out to the middle for the first time in ODI cricket.

OUT! Caught! Angelo Perera departs as soon as the stand reaches 50. Soft dismissal this for Perera. Full on middle, Perera looks to flick but does so uppishly. He finds the fielder to perfection and hits it straight to Haris Sohail. He makes no mistake and once again a wicket falls against the run of play. First wicket for Shinwari in this game. This should get him going as he was struggling today with his line and length.
Fuller around off, Perera runs it down to third man and gets a single to bring up the 50-run stand between the two.
Fuller on off, AP pushes it to cover for one. 150 comes up for Sri Lanka with that.
Follows it up with a single towards third man.
FOUR! Classic cover drive. Full around off, Gunathilaka bends his back and drives it with class through covers for a boundary. Moves to 94 now.
Effort ball. This is outside off, Gunathilaka leaves it alone.
Brilliant ball this. It is a very low full toss. Almost a yorker. Gunathilaka does very well to get his bat down and flick it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball on off, Perera defends it to covers.
Fuller one on the pads, Perera flicks it through mid-wicket for a couple.
Length ball outside off, Perera runs it down to third man for a couple.
Fuller one outside off, Perera strokes it to point. He needs to rotate strike.
Length and around off, Perera defends this one off the back foot to covers.
On a length and outside off, Perera defends it to the off side.
Usman Shinwari is back on.

SIX! Maximum to end the over. Riaz bowls it on  fuller length and Gunathilaka just lofts it with ease over long on and the ball crosses the fence on the full to get the biggie. First one from Sri Lanka and Danushka.
Fuller length outside off, Danushka defends it to point.
On a good length and outside off, Gunathilaka drives it through covers for a couple.
Length and on pads, Gunathilaka flicks it straight to mid-wicket.
Length and on middle and leg, Perera hops and works it across to mid-wicket for a single.
On a length and outside off, Perera defends it to point.
Wahab Riaz is back on. 3-0-16-0 his figures so far.
Tossed up on off, Angelo strokes it towards cover for one.
Now gets past mid-wicket with his flick for one.
Flicks this one but cannot go past mid-wicket.
FOUR! Excellent shot. Flighted on off, Gunathilaka goes straight and over. A safe shot. The ball bounces just inside the ropes and goes away to the fence.
Tossed up on middle, Perera nudges it to long on and gets to the other end.
Short on the pads, Gunathilaka glances it towards mid-wicket and gets a single. He was looking for two but Angelo rightfully sends him back as the second was never there.
Shorter on off, Angelo blocks it to get through the over.
Wrong 'un now. Very nicely bowled. It is on middle and off, DG defends it with soft hands towards cover for one.
Quicker around off, Gunathilaka looks to play the reverse sweep but the ball lobs wide of the bowler off his glove.
This time strokes it past mid off towards long off for one.
On the stumps, Angelo pushes it to mid off.
Short around off, Gunathilaka runs it down to third man for a single.
On the pads, AP flicks it towards mid-wicket.
On the stumps, Angelo defends it off the front foot.
On the pads, DG flicks it towards mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Cut and cut away with power. Short around off, Gunathilaka is in good form. He waits for it and then cuts it with power to get it past the man at point for a boundary.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
Tossed up around off, Angelo looks to sweep but gets an inside edge onto his boots. The ball deflects off towards short third man.
Oh! Shadab is a very lucky man.  He drags this one very short outside off, Gunathilaka looks to pull it over as the square leg region is open but unfortunately misses. He must be gutted with that.
Tossed up on middle, Angelo hits it hard straight towards Shadab. The ball deflects off his hand towards mid on for one.
Gives this one air on middle and leg, Gunathilaka whips it but straight to mid-wicket.
Flighted on off, Angelo strokes it to long off and rotates the strike.
On the pads, Gunathilaka glances it towards mid-wicket for one.
Tossed up on middle, Perera strokes it wide of mid on and takes a very quick single.
Flighted on off, Angelo strokes it towards long off and keeps the strike.
Follows it up with a single towards long on.

FOUR! Higher the risk, higher the reward they say and that is what has happened here. Floated on off, Gunathilaka gets down on one knee and reverse sweeps it against the spin. It comes off the upper half of his bat and goes uppishly over short third man for a boundary.
Floated on off, Angelo strokes it towards long off and gets off the mark.
Flighted on off, Perera defends it towards backward point. Babar misfields there but that does not cost any run.
Tossed up on off, Gunathilaka strokes it towards long on and gets to the other end.
On the pads, Gunathilaka glances it down the leg side for one and keeps the strike.

Excellent shot but no runs off it. Tossed up on off, Gunathilaka clears his front leg and hits it very hard and very straight. Too straight as the ball hits the stumps at the other end. Shadab does not get any hand to it so Perera is safe.
Flighted on middle and leg, Gunathilaka flicks it but cannot get through mid-wicket.
On the stumps, Danushka defends it off the front foot.
Another one on the pads, Gunathilaka glances it to mid-wicket once again.
On the pads, Gunathilaka flicks it towards mid-wicket.
Floated on off, Perera defends it off the front foot to get through the over. Excellent start for Mohammad. 3 runs and more importantly a big wicket of Thirimanne.
Angelo Perera replaces his skipper in the middle.

OUT! Caught! The change in bowling has brought the collapse of this partnership here. Nawaz has done the trick here. He gets rid of the Sri Lankan skipper. Nawaz bowls it slower through the air on middle and off. Thirimanne looks to drive it straight but he does so uppishly and ends up hitting it straight to Mohammad. He shows good reflexes and takes a solid catch off his own bowling. Much needed wicket for Pakistan. The left-arm spinner has done the trick here.
Shorter on off, Thirimanne guides it towards short third man.
Slower and spinning in. Gunathilaka flicks it with the spin towards fine leg for one. Sarfaraz says 'acha hai, acha hai' from behind the stumps. Meaning this is a good ball.
On the stumps, Thirimanne nudges it to long on for one. 100 comes up with the single.
Starts with a flighted delivery on off, Gunathilaka nudges it wide of cover for one.
Mohammad Nawaz to roll his arm over.
On the pads, Thirimanne flicks it to mid-wicket. No overthrow or any run on this occasion.

FOUR OVERTHROWS! Poor, poor effort from Abid Ali. Floated on middle and leg, Gunathilaka defends it with soft hands wide of mid-wicket. He calls for a quick single, Abid Ali gets to the ball and has a wild throw at the keeper's end. It is wide of not just the keeper but also backward point. It goes past everyone and to the fence.
Tossed up on off, Thirimanne strokes it towards cover for one.

On the pads, Thirimanne flicks it towards deep mid-wicket. Nawaz in the deep misfields as he struggles to bend enough to get down to the ball. Allowing them to get the second with ease. Sarfaraz won't be happy with that effort.
Flighted on off, Lahiru square drives it and gets a couple.
Floated on off, Thirimanne pushes it to mid off.
Short on off, LT punches it towards cover-point for one.
Darts one on the pads, Thirimanne looks to flick but misses.
Follows the boundary with a calm single towards cover.

FOUR! Gunathilaka gets to his fifty in style. This has been a brilliant knock from him. Sri Lanka needed someone to deliver from the top and he has done just that. Short around off, Gunathilaka waits for it and cuts it late to get it past the diving backward point fielder to fetch himself a boundary and get to his 9th ODI fifty.
Floated on off, Gunathilaka drives it towards mid off.
Shorter on off, Gunathilaka punches it to cover.

Drinks Break! The duo of Gunathilaka and Thirimanne have batted really well here. Having lost a wicket early on, the duo have not just laid a solid platform but have been smart in their approach. They have put the bad balls away and that has been the trademark of this partnership so far. Pakistan need to find a way to break this stand.
Nicely bowled. Gives air to this leg spinner, Thirimanne looks to defend but the ball spins away and squares him all ends up.
Shorter on off, Danushka punches it wide of cover for one.
Gives it air on off, Gunathilaka defends it off the front foot.
Floated on leg, Gunathilaka paddles it past short fine leg for a couple.
Flighted on off, LT drives it wide of cover for one.
Slightly quicker around off, Gunathilaka milks it to long on for one.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot.
On middle and leg, Gunathilaka looks to flick but the ball goes off the inner half of his bat towards backward square leg for a single.
Short on off, DG punches it but cannot go past cover.
Tossed up on off, Gunathilaka strokes it to mid off.
Shorter and slower outside off, Thirimanne punches it towards cover for a single.
Floated on off, Gunathilaka nudges it to cover for one.
Tossed up around middle and leg, Thirimanne works it wristily through mid-wicket for a couple.
Tossed up on middle, Danushka works it to square leg  for a single.

FOUR! EDGY! Flighted and outside off, Gunathilaka cuts it uppishly to get it past the point fielder. The fielder at third man runs across to his left but is in no position to cut that off as the ball crosses the fence.
Flighted and on middle, Danushka flicks it to mid-wicket once again.
Tossed up on middle, Gunathilaka flicks it to mid-wicket.
WIDE! Shadab loses his line and gets it one down the leg side. The umpire signals as wide.
Tossed up and on middle, Gunathilaka flicks it to mid-wicket.
Shadab Khan comes on now. Replaces Wahab Riaz.
Short on off, DG punches it to the off side for a single.
Gives this one air on off, Gunathilaka defends it.
Tossed up on middle, Thirimanne strokes it towards long  on for another easy single.
Shorter on off, Gunathilaka cuts it through point for one. Sarfaraz is not happy as he wants Iftikhar to bowl fuller.

Tossed up on middle and off, Thirimanne milks it to long on and gets a single to bring up the 50-run stand between the two. This has been a very good stand but they know they need to keep their heads down and continue the good work.
Flighted on off, Gunathilaka nudges it to long off for an easy single.
Length ball on off, Thirimanne strokes it to the man at cover.

FOUR! Good effort but all in vain. Back of a length ball outside off, Thirimanne waits for it and cuts it wide of point. Shinwari gives it a chase from third man and puts in a dive but his feet touch the rope as he makes contact with the ball. Full marks for the effort there.
Good length ball on off, Thirimanne guides it towards point.
Back of a length ball on middle, Gunathilaka pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for one.
Fuller one on middle, Danushka drives it down the ground. Wahab Riaz looks to field in his followthrough but fails and the batsmen cross a single.
Length and on off, Gunathilaka defends it to covers.
Flatter one on off, Danushka drives it through covers for a single.
Tassed up on off, Gunathilaka defends it off the front foot.
Tossed up and around off, Thirimanne defends it to covers.
Danushka skips down the track and drives this flatter one to long off for a single.
Flatter one on off, Gunathilaka pushes it through covers for a single.
Tossed up on off, Danushka defends it to mid off.
Good length ball on middle, Thirimanne strokes it to mid on.
Bouncer! Wahab bowls the effort ball but Thirimanne ducks under it without any fuss.
Another one on the pads, Thirimanne flicks it wide of mid-wicket and this time he gets a couple.
Fuller on middle, Thirimanne looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.

Could have been a disaster. On the pads, Gunathilaka flicks it wide of deep mid-wicket and looks for two. Thirimanne was never interested and sends him back. Luckily for Sri Lanka it does not cause any casualty.
Length ball around off, Thirimanne opens the face of the bat and runs it down to third man for one. 50 comes up for Sri Lanka with this single.
Powerplay 2 signalled by the umpire. Maximum of 4 fielders will be outside the 30-yard circle till the 40th over.
Tossed up on the stumps, DG blocks it. Sri Lanka are 49/1 at the end of Powerplay 1.
On the pads, Thirimanne flicks it towards mid-wicket for one.
Slightly shorter on off, Thirimanne pushes it to cover.
Much better. This is bowled flighted on off, Lahiru keeps it out.
WIDE! Pressure on the bowler. Iftikhar misses his line and bowls it down the leg side. Lahiru attempts to flick but misses.
FOUR! Short and punished. Iftikhar is guilty of bowling a loosener around off. Thirimanne waits for the ball to come and then cuts it late through third man for a boundary.
Floated on off, Thirimanne pushes it towards mid off.

FOUR! Punched and punched with power. Wahab bowls it slightly short but Gunathilaka was expecting it. He keeps his balance and punches it with power and with sheer timing through covers for a boundary.

Good fielding from Shadab. Saves runs for his side. Good length ball on off, Gunathilaka looks to run it down past the man at backward point. Shadab there dives to his right and saves runs for his side, keeping it down to a dot.
Hits the deck hard on off, DG defends it off his back foot.
Corrects his line and bowls it fuller on off. Gunathilaka pushes it to mid off.
FOUR! Poor ball from Wahab. He bowls it full on the pads, Gunathilaka flicks it with ease through mid-wicket for a boundary.
Wahab starts with a good length ball on off, Gunathilaka strokes it to point.
Change from both the ends. Wahab Riaz to operate now, partnering Iftikhar Ahmed.
Shorter around off, Thirmanne looks to cut but cannot get it past short third man. Maiden for Ahmed to start with.
Tossed up on off, Thirimanne strokes it towards mid on.
Flighted on off, Thirimanne pushes it to extra cover.
Gives this one air on off, Lahiru is in no hurry and calmly defends this one too.
Tosses it up on middle and leg, Lahiru defends it towards mid on.
Starts with a floated delivery on off, Thirimanne blocks it.
Bowling change. Spinner into the attack now. Iftikhar Ahmed is on now.
Full on off, Gunathilaka pushes it to mid off. Just 2 off the over.
Length delivery on off and middle, Lahiru runs it down towards backward point for one.
On middle and leg, Thirimanne pushes it to mid on and calls a loud no to his partner.
Good length ball on off and middle, Thirimanne defends it towards cover.
Hits the deck hard as Amir pulls his length back. Thirimanne defends it by getting right behind the line of this one.
Full and it comes in with the angle. Danushka flicks it this time towards square leg for one.
WIDE! Amir misses his line and bowls one down the leg side. Gunathilaka looks to flick but misses.

FOUR! Handsomely driven. Thirimanne is oozing class here. Shinwari bowls it on a fuller length and outside off, Thirimanne drives it off the front foot through cover for a boundary. Sri Lanka need some good hits and a good innings  from their skipper here.
Length and on off, Gunathilaka defends it to the off side.
On a length and on off, Thirimanne defends it to the off side.
Short and on off, Gunathilaka pulls it through mid-wicket for a single.
Length and on off, Danushka defends it back to the bowler.

FOUR! Driven beautifully through extra cover. On a fuller length and outside off, Gunathilaka leans and drives it crisply through covers. The ball goes to the fence like a bullet once it clears the infield.
Length and on off, Lahiru defends it to the off side.
Back of a length and on off, Thirimanne defends off the back foot.
On a fuller length, Gunathilaka cuts it past point for a single.
FOUR! Pulled with power. Amir goes short and on middle, Gunathilaka stands tall and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary. This should give some confidence to the opener.
Length and on pads, Thirimanne flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
On a fuller one and a slower one too. Thirimanne defends it off the front foot.
Maiden to end. A good comeback after a first over. Length ball on off, Gunathilaka defends it off the front foot.
Once again a good stop. Length ball outside off, Danushka cuts it to point.
Good delivery! Shinwari bowls it on a length and on off, the ball bounces past the outside edge. Gunathilaka was prodding forward to defend only to miss it.
Good stop by the fielder at point. Length and outside off, Danushka cuts it to point. The fielder there puts in a dive to his left to save a certain boundary.
Length ball on off, Danushka drives it straight down the ground only to be fielded by the bowler in his followthrough.
On a length and around off, Gunathilaka pushes it to covers.
On top of off, Lahiru keeps it out. End of a good over from Amir. 4 runs and a wicket off this one.
This time defends it right off the middle.
Better ball this. It is  on off and middle and zipping in. Thirimanne looks to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads. The ball lobs towards mid on but falls well short of the fielder there.
Follows it up with a calm front foot defense.

FOUR! Thirimanne is off the mark in style. Amir is guilty of bowling it on the pads, Lahiru flicks it with ease through mid-wicket. Wahab Riaz gives it a chase and pulls it back but as he does so his foot is touching the ropes. The umpire goes upstairs to confirm and the replays do confirm it.
Lahiru Thirimanne is the new man in. The skipper comes on early in the innings. The team needs him to score and take Sri Lanka to a good total.

OUT! Caught! Pakistan have drawn the first blood here. Amir steams in and bowls a good length delivery around off. It moves away just a hint off the deck. Avishka goes after it very loosely. He comes down the track and looks to drive it on the up. The ball kisses the outside edge of the bat and goes to the keeper. Sarfaraz Ahmed gets down in front and takes a very good catch. The Pakistan players are up in joy. Once again the top order has failed to deliver in this series.
Fuller and closer to the off pole. Gunathilaka pushes it to cover. Expensive start from Shinwari. 8 off his first.

FOUR! Shot! Excellent from Gunathilaka. Good length ball outside off, Danushka maintains his balance and cuts it right off the meat through cover-point for a boundary. A good indication of how good this surface is to bat on.
On the fourth stump line, Gunathilaka does not disturb that.
On the pads, Gunathilaka flicks it but straight to mid-wicket.
Better line this as this is on a length and on top of middle. Gunathilaka pushes it to mid on.
FOUR! Poor start from the Shinwari. It is on the pads, Gunathilaka has no problem flicking it fine down the leg side. It is fine of the fielder at fine leg and he has no chance stopping that.
Usman Shinwari to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
Hits the deck hard on middle and leg, Fernando defends it towards mid on. 5 off the first.

FOUR! Not the most convincing way to get off the mark but Avishka is not complaining. Full around off, Fernando looks to drive but the ball hits the outer half of his bat and turns in his hand. It is wide of the fielder at mid off. The fielder does not give it a go and the ball beats him to the fence.
Full on middle, Fernando defends it towards mid on.
Pulls his length back for the first time and bowls it on top of off. Avishka calmly blocks it.
Once again Amir bowls it full but this one is around off. Once again a bit of assistance for him as the ball swings in. Fernando defends it to mid off.

Sri Lanka are off the mark straightaway. Amir starts with a full ball which swings away just a hint from middle and off. Gunathilaka pushes it wide of mid off and calls for a quick single. He is quick to get to the other end as the fielder misses his shy at the bowler's end. Had he hit then too Gunathilaka would have been in.

We are all set for the start of the match. Both the umpires make their way out in the middle. The Pakistan players follow them out on the field. Avishka Fernando and Danushka Gunathilaka stride out to open the innings for Sri Lanka. With the latter set to take the strike. Mohammad Amir to start the proceedings with the first new ball. Two slips in place for him to start with.

SRI LANKA Playing XI - Lahiru Thirimanne (C), Danushka Gunathilaka, Avishka Fernando, Angelo Perera (IN for Oshada Fernando), Minod Bhanuka(WK) (IN for Sadeera Samarawickrama), Shehan Jayasuriya, Dasun Shanaka, Wanindu Hasaranga, Lakshan Sandakan (IN for Isuru Udana), Nuwan Pradeep, Lahiru Kumara.

PAKISTAN Playing XI - Fakhar Zaman, Abid Ali (IN for Imam-ul-Haq), Babar Azam, Haris Sohail, Iftikhar Ahmed, Sarfaraz Ahmed (WK/C), Mohammad Nawaz (IN for Imad Wasim), Wahab Riaz, Shadab Khan, Mohammad Amir, Usman Shinwari.

TOSS - We are all set for the spin of coin for the final time in Karachi for this series. Pakistan skipper, Sarfaraz Ahmed has the coin in hand. Up it goes and comes down in favor of Thirimanne. SRI LANKA OPT TO BAT!

Hello and welcome to the coverage of the third and final ODI of this 3-match ODI series between Pakistan and Sri Lanka. The hosts had a happy welcome back to their original backyard. As they completely outplayed and outclassed the visiting Sri Lankans. Babar Azam proved why he is highly rated in the cricketing circuit with a blistering ton. The hosts were good with the ball too with Usman Shinwari the star with a 5-fer. Sarfaraz Ahmed and co will now be looking to repeat the same in the 3rd ODI and wrap up the series. The visitors, on the other hand, have a lot to work on if they want to upset the hosts. They were sub-par in all the departments. They reached a respectable target courtesy of an excellent partnership between Shehan Jayasuriya and  Dasun Shanaka. It was their 177-run stand that reduced the defeat margin to just 67. Skipper, Thirimanne has a lot to think about before his side sets foot on the pitch for the final ODI. Can the Sri Lankan lions find some inspiration and roar back or will Pakistan continue their dominance? Stay tuned to find out as the toss is not far away.
